blocks.x: Each Tele Medicine Platform deployment starts with one decision class in production — not a program of twenty. The evidence pack grows with the rollout, so by the time the third use case goes live, the audit story is already routine.

Operators see Tele Medicine Platform as one more decision surface with one difference: every recommendation carries its evidence, and every override is logged with a reason. The rollout order differs by industry; the operator experience does not — fewer surprises, faster answers, and a trail that makes the post-incident review short.
The next step is small and real: one working session on a working session on Tele Medicine Platform, your data, and a written feasibility read you can circulate.
